verdict.rationale: Browser Use is a cloud agent and browser service handling user data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA badges are adjacent compliance claims, and running the open-source library locally with your own LLM is a user-side workaround; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
